title: Alya UI for Minecraft PE — Anime UI Pack
topic: Minecraft Bedrock/PE ke liye Alya-inspired anime UI pack ka visual showcase.
description: Minecraft Bedrock/PE ke liye Alya-inspired anime UI pack ka visual showcase. Pack ka purpose game ki interface ko Alya anime theme dena hai — world ke blocks ya survival mechanics badalne ke bajaye main menu, loading screens aur menu panels ka appearance customise hota hai. Video mein short preview ke through pack ka aesthetic dikhaya gaya hai.
